k.aa.aa.html: כ, כּ eleventh letter ; used as numeral 20 in postBHeb.; כא = 21, כב = 22, etc.

k.ab.aa.html:
כְּ prop. subst. the like of, like, as
1
a quantitatively: as many
b qualitatively, to express resemblance in respect of some attribute, action, character, appearance, etc.: the like of
c as an accus. of mode or limitation, in or with the like of
d sometimes כְּ is used in partic. to compare an object with the class to which it belongs, and express its correspondence with the idea which it ought to realize
2 repeated כְּ … כְּ, to signify the completeness of the correspondency between two objects
3 before an inf.:
a like
b of time, about, at

k.ab.ab.html:
כַּאֲשֶׁר conj. according as, as, when
1 according to that which, according as, as
2 with a causal force, in so far as, since
3 with a temporal force, when

k.ab.ac.html: כְּמוֹ adv. and conj. like, as, when (lit. the like of what (viz.) …, a pleon. form of כְּ (v. מוֹ), and, like it, prop. a subst.)

k.ac.aa.html:
כָּאַב vb. be in pain
Qal
1 be in pain, physical
2 of mental pain
Hiph. pain, mar

k.ad.aa.html:
[כָּאָה] vb. Niph. be disheartened, cowed
Niph. then shall he be cowed; downhearted
Hiph. Inf. cstr.

k.ad.ab.html: [כָּאֶה] adj. cowed, ψ 10:10 Qr

k.ae.aa.html: כבב (√ of foll., cf. Sta §116, 3; meaning not wholly clear; Ar. Arabic is roll threads into a ball, Arabic ball of thread, but also troop of horses, band of men, etc.; Eth. Ethiopic is in orbem circumsistere, Ethiopic orbis, circulus, etc.; hence perh. star, as round, or as collected in bands, clusters, constellations; As. kabâbu = burn; kabâbê, shields, is written kabâbê by Dl HWB 578).

k.af.aa.html:
כָּבֵד vb. be heavy, weighty, burdensome, honoured
Qal
1 be heavy, in weight
2 heavy, insensible, dull
3 be honoured
Niph.
1 pass.
a be made heavy fr. abundance
b be honoured, enjoy honour, of man
2 medial, get oneself glory (or honour), of God
Pi.
1 make heavy, insensible
2 make honourable, honour, glorify, usu. c. human subj.
Pu. be made honourable, honoured
Hiph.
1 make heavy
2 make heavy, dull, unresponsive, the ears
3 cause to be honoured
Hithp.
1 make oneself heavy, dense, numerous
2 honour oneself

k.af.ac.html: כָּבֵד n.m. La 2:11 liver (explained by Thes (quoting Galen) as the heavy organ, par excellence, of the body)

k.af.ad.html:
כֹּ֫בֶד n.[m.]
1 heaviness, weight of a stone
2 mass, abundance, of corpses
3 vehemence, of war

k.af.af.html:
כָּבוֹד n.m. and f. abundance, honour, glory
1 abundance, riches
2 honour, splendor, glory, of external condition and circumstances
3 honour, dignity of position
4 honour, reputation, of character
5 my honour, poet. of the seat of honour in the inner man, the noblest part of man
6 honour, reverence, glory, as due to one or ascribed to one
7 glory as the object, of honour, reverence and glorifying

k.af.ag.html: כְּבוּדָּ֯ה n.f. abundance, riches Ju 18:21.

k.ag.aa.html:
[כָּבָה] vb. be quenched, extinguished, go out, of fire or lamp
Qal be quenched, extinguished
Pi. quench, extinguish

k.ag.ab.html:
כָּבוּל n.pr.loc.
1 city on border of Asher
2 district in Galilee containing 20 cities given by Sol. to Hiram

k.ah.aa.html: כבל (√ of foll. = bind; NH כָּבַל bind, כֶּבֶל fetter; Aram. כְּבַל id., כַּבְלָא id., Syriac, Syriac; Ar. Arabic bind, Arabic fetter).

k.ai.aa.html: כבן (√ of foll., mng. dub.; NH כָּבַן, Aram. כבן, Syriac = wrap round, wrap up).

k.ai.ab.html: כַּבוֹן n.pr.loc. in Judah Jos 15:40

k.ai.ad.html: מַכְבַּנַּי n.pr.m. a hero of David 1 Ch 12:14.

k.aj.aa.html:
[כָּבַס] 51 vb. (tread), wash
Qal highway of fuller’s (= treader’s, washer’s) field
Pi.
1 wash garments (i.e. by treading)
2 wash person
Pu. be washed, of garment
Hothp. after the plague is washed out

k.ak.aa.html:
[כָּבַר] vb. be much, many
Hiph. (only Elihu) make many

k.ak.ab.html: כַּבִּיר adj. great, mighty, much, only poet.

k.ak.ac.html: [כִּבְרָה] n.f. appar. distance, only in the phr. a distance of land or length of way

k.ak.ae.html: כְּבָר n.pr.fl. Kĕbār, a river (or perhaps a canal) of Babylonia, not at present identified, by wh. the exiles, among whom Ez. ministered, were settled

k.al.aa.html: כבר (√ of foll.; ? to intertwine, net; NH כָּבַר sift is denom. fr. כְּבָרָה).

k.al.ab.html: [כָּבִיר] n.[m.] prob. something netted, i.e. either a quilt or a fly-net spread over the face while a person was asleep

k.al.ac.html: כְּבָרָה n.f. a sieve (a net-like implement), Am 9:9

k.al.ad.html: מַכְבֵּר n.[m.] a netted cloth or coverlet; 2 K 8:15 of the cloth which Hazael dipped in water, and spread over Ben-hadad’s face to smother him.

k.al.af.html: כֶּ֫בֶשׂ 107 n.m. lamb

k.am.aa.html:
[כָּבַשׁ] vb. subdue, bring into bondage
Qal
1 bring into bondage
2 (late) subdue, force, a woman
3 subdue, dominate, the earth
Niph. pass.
Pi. (of conquest)
Hiph. bring into bondage

k.am.ab.html: כֶּ֫בֶשׁ n.[m.] footstool (late)—2 Ch 9:18 (of Solomon’s throne).

k.am.ac.html: כִּבְשָׁן n.m. kiln, for lime or pottery

k.an.aa.html: כדד (√ of foll.; Ar. Arabic is toil severely; Arabic fatigue, weary, harass, tread; Arabic mortar in which things are pounded, bruised; Arabic what remains in bottom of cooking-pot).

k.an.ac.html: [כִּידוֹד] n.m. spark—only pl. cstr. Jb 41:11 of breath of crocodile

k.an.ad.html: כַּדְכֹּד n.[m.] a precious stone, perh. ruby

k.ao.aa.html: כדר (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic VII. shoot or rush down (of hawk, star, etc.; also of an attacking force) so Thes Fl in De Job 15, 24 Buhl Di al.; v. also mod. Ar. Arabic annoy, vex, reprimand, Spiro Vocab.; Arabic oftener be dark, gloomy, turbid, whence > כידור = seething tumult, of battle, cf. Kö ii. 147, §71, 1).

k.ao.ac.html: כַּדּוּר n.[m.] ball Is 22:18, as in Talm.; circle, cordon

k.ap.aa.html:
כֹּה demonstr.adv. thus, here
1 of manner, thus
2 of place, here
3 of time, hitherto

k.ap.ab.html: כָּ֫כָה 37 adv. thus

k.aq.aa.html:
[כָּהָה] vb. be or grow dim, faint
Qal grow dim
Pi. grow faint

k.aq.ac.html: כֵּהָה n.f. (dimming), lessening, alleviation;—of Nineveh Na 3:19

k.ar.aa.html: [כָּהָה] vb. Pi. rebuke, only 1 S 3:13

k.as.aa.html: כהן (√ of foll; mng. dub., v. Dr 28 6, 18; Ar. vb. Arabic is divine, and Arabic (Qor 52:29) is a seer, the organ (mostly) of a jinn, rarely of a god: the Arabic and the כֹּהֵן must have been orig. identical (both alike being guardians of an oracle, at a sanctuary); but their functions diverged: the Arabic gradually lost his connexion with the sanctuary, and sank to be a mere diviner; the כהן acquired fuller sacrif. functions: v. RS Enc. Brit. ed. 9, xix, 727; We Skizzen iii. 130f., 167; Now Arch ili. 89f.; Ph כהן is priest כהנת priestess).

k.as.ab.html: כֹּהֵן 750 n.m. priest

k.as.ac.html: [כָּהַן] vb. only Pi. denom. act as priest

k.at.aa.html:
[כָּוָה] vb. burn, scorch, brand
Niph. be scorched

k.at.ab.html: כִּי n.[m.] burning, branding—only Is 3:24

k.at.ac.html: כְּוִיָּה n.f. id. [כִּי]; Ex 21:25.

k.at.ad.html: מִכְוָה n.f. burnt-spot, scar of a burn; Lv 13:24

k.au.aa.html:
[כּוּל] vb. comprehend, contain
Qal who hath comprehended the dust of the earth in a shalish-measure
Pilp. sustain, maintain, contain
Polp. were supplied with food
Hiph. contain, hold, hold in, endure

k.au.ab.html: כַּלְכֹּל n.pr.m. one of the wise men whom Solomon surpassed

k.av.aa.html: כום (√ of foll.; Ar. Arabic II. is heap up, accumulate; Arabic heap; Arabic herd of camels, hence perh. כִּימָה as a group, herd, or flock of stars, but uncertain (v. כִּימָה)).

k.aw.aa.html:
[כּוּן] 218 vb. prob. be firm, only in der. conj.
Niph.
1 be set up, established, fixed
2 in a moral sense, be directed aright, of ways
3 prepare, be ready
4 pass. be prepared, of judgments
Hiph.
1 establish, set up
2
a fix, so as to be ready, make ready, prepare, a gift
b provide for, provide, furnish
3 direct one's face toward
4 arrange, order
Hoph.
1 be established, of throne
2 be prepared for
Po‛lēl.
1 set up, establish
2 constitute, make, a man (in womb)
3 fix, so as to be ready
4 direct
Po‛lal. be established
Hithpo‛l. be established

k.aw.ab.html:
כֵּן adj. right, veritable, honest
1 right
2 veritable, true
3 pl. concr. honest (men)

k.aw.ad.html: כּוֹנַנְיָ֫הוּ Kt, כֳּנַנְיָ֫הוּ Qr, n.pr.m. Levites.

k.aw.ae.html:
יָכִין n.pr.m. (he will establish)
1 a Simeonite
2 name of right-hand pillar before temple

k.aw.af.html: יָכִינִי adj.gent. with art. as n.coll. Nu 26:12.

k.aw.ag.html: יְכוֹנְיָה n.pr.m. (י׳ is firm, enduring) all of last king but one of Judah

k.aw.ah.html: מָכוֹן n.m. fixed or established place, foundation (chiefly poet.)

k.aw.ai.html: מְכוֹנָה, מְכֹנָה 25 n.f. fixed resting-place, base

k.aw.aj.html: נָכוֹן n.pr.m. only in 2 S 6:6

k.aw.ak.html: תְּכוּנָה n.f. arrangement, preparation, fixed place

k.aw.al.html: [כַּוָּן] n.[m.] cake, sacrificial cake—only pl.

k.aw.an.html: כּוֹס n.[m.] a kind of owl

k.ax.aa.html: כור (√ of foll.; perh. be or make round, hence furnace, pot, basin, fr. shape; Ar. Arabic wind about (e.g. a turban), Arabic turn or twist (of turban), Arabic blacksmith's fire-place, hornets' or bees' nest, Arabic bundle; > Thes comp. Syr. Syriac incaluit (Lexx. aestuavit, calefactus est)).

k.ax.ae.html: [כִּיר] n.[m.] cooking-furnace—frangible, only du. Lv 11:35

k.ax.af.html:
כִּיֹּר, כִּיּוֹר n.m. 1 K 7:38 pot, basin
1 pot for cooking
2 fire-pot
3 basin of bronze for washing, laver; set on a bronze support
4 platform or stage of bronze (prob. round, bowl-like in shape) on which, acc. to Chr, Solomon stood and kneeled

k.ay.aa.html: [כוּר] vb. mng. dub., perh. bore, or dig, or hew—only Qal ψ 22:17

k.ay.ab.html: [מְכֹרָה, מְכוּרָה] n.f. origin (i.e. place of digging out?)

k.ay.ac.html: [מְכֵרָה] n.[f.] prob. the name of a weapon, only pl. Gn 49:5

k.ay.ad.html: כּ֫וֹרֶשׁ and כֹּ֫רֶשׁ n.pr.m. Cyrus—king of Persia, conqueror of Babylon, restorer of Jews to Palestine

k.az.aa.html:
כּוּשׁ n.pr.pers.m., gent. et terr.
1 1st ‘son’ of חָם
2 land and people of southern Nile-valley, or Upper Egypt, extending from Syene indefinitely to the south
3 כּוּשׁ is err. for כַּשׁ = Bab. Kaššu

k.az.ab.html: כּוּשׁ n.pr.m. a Benjamite, ψ 7:1 (title)

k.az.ac.html:
כּוּשִׁי adj.gent.
a sg. agreeing with noun
b = subst., a Cushite
c id. c. art., the Cushite, of Joab’s adjutant
d pl. = subst.

k.az.ad.html:
כּוּשִׁי n.pr.m.
1 great-grandfather of יְהוּדִי
2 father of prophet Zephaniah

k.az.ae.html: כּוּשָׁן n.pr., gent. vel terr., only Hb 3:7

k.az.af.html: כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַ֫יִם n.pr.m. king of Aram Naharaim

k.az.ah.html: כּוּתָה, כּוּת n.pr.loc. whence king of Assyria (Sargon) transported colonists into N. Israel

k.ba.aa.html:
[כָּזַב] vb. lie, be a liar
Qal Pt.
Niph. his hope has been made deceptive
Pi.
1 lie, tell a lie
2 disappoint, fail
Hiph. who will make me a liar? i.e. prove me to be so

k.ba.ab.html: כָּזָב n.m. lie, falsehood, deceptive thing

k.ba.ac.html: כְּזִיב n.pr.loc. in plain of Judah Gn 38:5

k.ba.ae.html: כָּזְבִי n.pr.f. a woman of Midian

k.ba.ag.html:
אַכְזִיב n.pr.loc.
1 in lowland of Judah
2 in Asher

k.bb.aa.html: כזר (√ of foll.; Aram. Ethpe. be cruel (𝔗 Jb 10:1 ), cf. Syr. Syriac, miles, vir strenuus PS 1718, who comp. Pers. Persian athleta, heros (Vullers)).

k.bb.ac.html: אַכְזָרִי adj. cruel, always in this form

k.bb.ad.html: אַכְזְרִיּוּת n.f. cruelty, fierceness, only Pr 27:4

k.bb.ae.html: כֹּחַ n.[m.] a small reptile, prob. a kind of lizard, in list of unclean creeping things Lv 11:30; chameleon

k.bc.aa.html:
[כָּחַד] vb. not in Qal; Pi. Hiph. hide, efface; Niph. (usu.) pass.
Niph.
1 be hidden
2 be effaced, destroyed
Pi. hide
Hiph.
1 hide
2 efface, annihilate

k.bd.aa.html: כחח (√ assumed by Thes Buhl al. for foll. Ba NB 79 prop. √ כוח).

k.bd.ab.html: כֹּחַ and כּוֹחַ n.m. strength, power

k.be.aa.html: [כָּחַל] vb. paint (eyes)—only in Ez 23:40

k.bf.aa.html:
כָּחַשׁ vb. be disappointing, deceive, fail, grow lean
Qal my flesh hath grown lean (away) fr. fatness
Niph. thine enemies shall cringe
Pi.
1 deceive
2 act deceptively against
3 cringe = come cringing
4 disappoint, fail
Hithp. shall come cringing to me

k.bf.ac.html: [כֶּחָשׁ] adj. deceptive, false—Is 30:9

k.bg.aa.html:
כִּי conj. that, for, when
1 that
2
a Of time, when, of the past
b elsewhere כִּי has a force approximating to if, though it usu. represents a case as more likely to occur than אִם
c when or if, with a concessive force, i.e. though
3 Because, since

k.bg.ab.html:
כִּי אם־
1 each part. retaining its independent force, and relating to a different clause:
a that if
b for if
2 (About 140 t.) the two particles being closely conjoined, and relating to the same clause—
a limiting the prec. clause, except
b the if being neglected, and treated as pleonastic, so that the clause is no longer a limitation of the preceding clause but a contradiction of it: but rather, but
c after an oath, surely

k.bg.ae.html: [כִּיד] n.[m.] only Jb 21:20, meaning unknown; rd. prob. his misfortune

k.bh.aa.html: כיד (√ of foll.; cf. perh. Ar. Arabic in sense labour, take pains, strive, or struggle with, Arabic war).

k.bh.af.html: כִּיּוּן n.pr.dei Am 5:26, prob. = As. kaivânu, planet Saturn (Ar. and Pers. Arabic, Syr. Syriac), regarded as god; orig. pronunc. כֵּיוָן Schr COT ad loc., cf. Kö ii. 151 (pointing כִּיּוּן intended to suggest √ כון as something established, firm); kaimânu = kaiânu, acc. to Jen Cosm. iii. 502 who der. fr. כון (cf. Thes; so Zim BP 17); > Hpt ZA ii. 266, 281 f. rds. כַּיָּוָן (for כְּאָמָן *), reading Babyl. name Kaʼâmânu; v. also M-A JBL 1892, xi. 86 n. 39.

k.bh.ah.html: כִּילַי כֵּלַי Is 32:5, 7 v. נכל (Kö ii. 118).

k.bh.ai.html: כֵּילַפּוֹת n.[f.] axe (loan-word (cf. Frä 74) fr. As. kalappatu v. DI HWB 333)—בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכ׳ יַהֲלֹמ֑וּן ψ 74:6 (∥ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת v 5).

k.bh.ak.html:
כִּיס n.m. Pr 1:14 bag, purse (perh. kindred with כּוֹס, q.v.; Ar. Arabic (prob. fr. Pers. Persian Lane 2640); Eth. Ethiopic NH כִּיס; Aram. כִּיסָא, Syriac; Palm. מן כיסה from his purse = at his own expense, Vog p. 13 al.)—bag, in which were carried:
a weights (v. אֶבֶן 5) Dt 25:13 Mi 6:11 Pr 16:11;
b money, i.e. a purse Is 46:6 Pr 1:14.

k.bh.al.html: כִּיֹּר, [כִּיר], כִּירַיִם v. sub I. כור.

k.bh.an.html: כָּ֫כָה v. sub כה p. 462 supr.

k.bi.aa.html:
[כָּלָא] vb. shut up, restrain, withhold (NH id.; Aram. כְּלָא, Syriac; Eth. Ethiopic restrain, hinder; As. kâlû, id.; Ar. Arabic protect Qor 21:43 cf. Ba ZMG 1887, 605 Anm. 4)—
Qal Pf. 3 ms. sf. כְּלָאוֹ Je 32:3; 3 fs. כָּֽלְאָה Hg 1:10; 2 fs. sf. כְּלִתִ֫נִי I S 25:33; 1 s. כָּלִאתִי ψ 119:101; 3 pl. כָּֽלְאוּ Hg 1:10, כָּלוּ I S 6:10; Impf. 3 ms. יִכְלֶה Gn 23:6; 2 ms. תִכְלָא ψ 40:12; 2 fs. תִּכְלָ֑אִי Is 43:6; 1 s. אֶכְלָא ψ 40:10; Imv. sf. כְּלָאֵֽם Nu 11:28; Inf. cstr. לִכְלוֹא Ec 8:8; Pt. pass. כָלוּא Je 32:2, כָּלֻא ψ 88:9; (on the metapl. forms, as if fr. כלה, v. Ges § 76, 21 c Kö i. 611);—
1 shut up, c. acc. I S 6:10 (+ בְ loc.), Je 32:3; pt. pass. Je 32:2 (בְ loc.), fig. ψ 88:9 (opp. יצא).
2 restrain, c. acc. I S 25:33 (+ מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים), ψ 119:101 (+ מִכָּל־); כְּלָאֵם (sc. מֵהִתְנַבֵּא) Nu 11:28; כ׳ שְׂפָתַי ψ 40:10; כ׳ אֶת־הָרוּחַ Ec 8:8. On ψ 74:11 v. כלה Pi. 2.
3 withhold, כ׳ אֶת־קִבְרוֹ מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶֽךָ Gn 23:6 (P), כ׳ רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי ψ 40:12, Hg 1:10 b, prob. also v a (rd. מָ֑ל for MT 𝔊 מִטָּ֑ל, We); abs. אַל־תִּכְלָאִי (sc. exiles) Is 43:6 (∥ תְּנִי).
Niph. Impf. וַיִּכָּלֵא הַגֶּשֶׁם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם Gn 8:2 (J), and the rain from heaven was restrained, cf. וַיִּכָּלְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים Ez 31:15 (in fig.; ∥ מנע); וַיִּכָּלֵא הָעָם מֵהָבִיא Ex 36:6 (P).
Pi. [Pf. כִּלָּא and] Inf. cstr. לְכַלֵּא v. כלה Pi.

k.bi.ab.html: כֶּ֫לֶא n.[m.] confinement, restraint, imprisonment;—abs. כ׳ 1 K 22:27 + 6 t.; sf. כִּלְאוֹ 2 K 25:29 Je 52:33; pl. כְלָאִים Is 42:22;—confinement, in combin. בֵּית (ה)כ׳ (cf. As. bit kili, prison, DI HWB 328) 1 K 22:27 = 2 Ch 18:26, 2 K 17:4 Je 37:15, 18 Is 42:7; בָּֽתֵּי כְלָאִים v 22 (cf. בָּיִת 1 (ε) (2) p. 109 supr.; v. also כלוא infr.); בִּגְדֵי כִלְאוֹ 2 K 25:29 = Je 52:33 garments of imprisonment = prison garb.

k.bi.ac.html: כלוא Kt, כְּלִיא Qr n.[m.] id. [k.bi.ab];—בֵּ֥ית הַכּ׳ Je 37:4 52:31 (v. כֶּלֶא supr.)

k.cx.ab.html: כַּפְתּוֹר, כַּפְתֹּר n.m. 1. capital. 2. knob, bulb

k.cx.ad.html: [כַּפְתֹּרִי] adj.gent., only pl. as subst. Cretans

k.cx.ah.html: [כרבל] vb. either denom. be-mantle (from BAram. כַּרְבְּלָא, if this = mantle), or poss. quadril. bind round (from כבל, with ins. ר);—only Pu. 1 Ch 15:27

k.cy.aa.html:
כָּרָה vb. dig
Qal dig a grave; a well; a pit
Niph. until the pit be digged of the wicked, fig. of judgment.

k.cy.ab.html: [כָּרָה] n.f. cistern (or well), only pl. cstr. in Zp 2:6

k.cy.ac.html: [מִכְרֶה] n.m. pit (?), only cstr. Zp 2:9

k.cz.aa.html: [כָּרָה] vb. get by trade, trade

k.da.aa.html: [כָּרָה] vb. give a feast;—only Qal 2 K 6:23

k.da.ab.html: כֵּרָה n.f. a feast, 2 K 6:23 (si vera l.; v. foregoing [k.da.aa]).

k.da.ac.html:
כְּרוּב 91 n.m. cherub
1 the living chariot of the theophanic God
2 as guards of the garden of Eden
3 as the throne of Yahweh Sabaoth
4 P gives an account
5 K and Ch describe the cherubim of the temple
6 Ezekiel describes the cherubim

k.da.ad.html: כָּרִי adj.gent. prob. = Carian, only c. art. as subst. coll. Carians, name given to foreign body-guard of king

k.db.aa.html: כרך (√ of following; cf. Aram. כְּרַךְ, Syriac enwrap, surround, כְּרִיכַא, Syriac bundle, כַּרְכָּא, Syriac city (+ many other deriv.); כְּרִיכָא, Syriac, NH כֶּרֶךְ, scroll, etc.)

k.dc.aa.html: כרכב quadril. (√ of following; cf. NH כִּרְכֵּב, furnish with a rim, enclose, set).

k.dc.ab.html: כַּרְכֹּב n.[m.] border, rim, of altar

k.dc.ad.html: כַּרְכְּמִישׁ, כַּרְכְּמִשׁ n.pr.loc. city on Euphrates

k.dc.ae.html: כַּרְכַּס n.pr.m. Pers., a eunuch of Ahasuerus, Est 1:10.

k.dd.aa.html: כֶּרֶם 92 n.m. (f.) vineyard

k.dd.ab.html: כָּרַם vb. denom. tend vineyards, dress vines, only Qal Pt. pl. vinedressers

k.dd.ac.html:
כַּרְמִי n.pr.m.
1 son of Reuben
2 a Judaite

k.dd.ad.html: כַּרְמִי adj.gent. only c. art., as subst. Nu 26:6.

k.dd.ae.html: כַּרְמֶל n.m. 1. plantation, garden-land. 2. fruit, garden-growth

k.dd.af.html:
כַּרְמֶל n.pr.mont. et urb. Carmel
1 mt.-promontory on Mediterranean, with fertile slopes, Tel el-Amarna
2 city, 3 h. S. of Hebron

k.dd.ag.html: כַּרְמְלִי adj.gent., c. art., the Carmelite, of Nabal. f. הַכַּרְמְלִית the Carmelitess, of Abigail.

k.dd.ah.html: כַּרְמִיל n.[m.] crimson, carmine, i.e. crimson stuff, cloth; late

k.de.aa.html:
כָּרַע bow down
Qal
1 bow
2 bow down, of the crouching lion
3 bow down over (in order to lie with) a woman
4 bow down, of a woman in childbirth
Hiph.
1 cause to bow in grief
2 cause to bow down in death

k.de.ac.html: כַּרְפַּס n.m. cotton (or fine linen);—Est 1:6

k.df.aa.html: [כָּרַר] vb. √ of foll.;—only Pilpēl, Pt. dancing (lit. whirling)

k.df.ad.html: כִּכָּר n.f. a round: hence 1. a round district. 2. a round loaf. 3. a round weight, talent

k.dg.aa.html: כרשׂ √ of foll. (Ar. Arabic wrinkled).

k.dg.ab.html: [כְּרֵשׂ] n.[m.] belly;—only Je 51:34 of Nebuchadrezzar under fig. of sea-monster.

k.dg.ad.html: כַּרְשְׁנָא n.pr.m. a Pers. prince Est 1:14.

k.dh.aa.html:
כָּרַת 291 vb. cut off, cut down
Qal
1 cut off
2 cut down
3 hew, timber
4 cut, or make a covenant
Niph.
1 be cut off
2 be cut down
3 be chewed between the teeth
4 be cut off, in a more general sense fail
Pual
1 be cut off
2 be cut down
Hiph.
1 cut off, flattering lips
2 cut off, destroy the life of
3 cut down, destroy, cities
4 take away
5 permit to perish

k.dh.ac.html: כְּרִית n.pr. the brook where Elijah was hidden

k.dh.ad.html: כְּרֹת כָּרָה v. כָּרָה sub. כרה

k.dh.ae.html: כְּרֵתִי adj.gent., always c. art., or pl., as subst., Kerethites, a name for Philistines or a part of them (perhaps = Cretans)

k.dh.ag.html: כֶּ֫שֶׂד n.pr.m. son of Nahor acc. to Gn 22:22 (J).

k.dh.ah.html: כַּשְׂדִּים n.pr.gent. et terr. Kasdim = Chaldeans, Chaldea

k.di.aa.html: [כָּשָׂה] vb. be sated, gorged with food;—only Qal De 32:15

k.dj.aa.html:
כָּשַׁל vb. stumble, stagger, totter
Qal
1 stumble at, over, something (lit. by means of)
2 totter
Niph.
1 stumble
2 be tottering, feeble
Pi. only apparent
Hiph.
1 cause to stumble
2 make feeble, weak
Hoph. either and let them be ones who have stumbled before thee, i.e. regard them as such, or and let them be ones overthrown before thee

k.dj.ac.html: כִּשָּׁלוֹן n.[m.] a stumbling; fig. = calamity Pr 16:18.

k.dj.ad.html: מִכְשׁוֹל n.m. a stumbling, means or occasion of stumbling, stumbling-block

k.dk.aa.html: כשׁף (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic cut off, cut up, Syr. Syriac to pray (lit. prob. to cut oneself v. 1 K 18:28): so RS JPhil. xiv. 125, 126 Nö ZMG 1886, 723; acc. to RS כֶּשֶׂף is prop, herbs etc. shredded into a magic brew).

k.dk.ac.html: כִּשֵּׁף vb. Pi. denom. practice sorcery

k.dk.ad.html: [כַּשָּׁף] n.m. sorcerer, only pl. sf.;—Je 27:9.

k.dl.ab.html: אַכְשָׁף n.pr.loc. in (Northern) Canaan, with a king; situated on the border of Asher

k.dm.aa.html:
כָּשֵׁר vb. be advantageous, proper, suitable, succeed
Qal and the thing be proper in the view of the king
Hiph. an advantage for giving success in wisdom.

k.dm.ac.html: [כּוֹשָׁרָה] n.f. prosperity. Only pl. intens. ψ 68:7

k.dm.ad.html: כִּישׁוֹר n.[m.] distaff;—only in Pr 31:19

k.dn.aa.html:
כָּתַב 223 vb. write
Qal
1 write
2 = write down, describe in writing
3 = register, enroll
4 = decree
Niph.
1 be written
2 = be written down, recorded
Pi. frequent.

k.dn.ab.html:
כְּתָב n.m. writing
1 register, enrolment
2 = mode of writing, character, letter
3 = letter
4 of a royal enactment, edict
5 of a writing with divine authority

k.dn.ac.html: כְּתֹ֫בֶת n.f. only cstr. Lv 19:28 i.e. a writing (mark or sign) of imprintment, scriptio stigmatis, perh. of tattooing

k.dn.ad.html:
מִכְתָּב n.m. writing
1 = hand-writing
2 = thing written
3 in a title

k.dn.ae.html: [כִּתִּי] adj.gent. alw. pl.; usu. as n.gent. = Cypriotes

k.do.aa.html: כתל (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic make into firm lumps or blocks, make compact; Frey also bind, imprison, Arabic be joined together).

k.do.ab.html: [כֹּ֫תֶל] n.[m.] wall of house;—only sf. Ct 2:9.

k.do.ac.html: כִּתְלִישׁ n.pr.loc. a city of Judah Jos 15:40, site unknown

k.dp.aa.html: [כָּתַם] vb. only Niph. be stained

k.dq.ab.html: מִכְתָּם n.[m.] Mikhtām, a term. techn. in ψ-titles, meaning unknown

k.dq.ac.html: כֶּ֫תֶם n.m. gold, poet. and late

k.dr.aa.html: כתן (√ of foll., = clothe? so Zehnpf. BAS i. 532, who der. therefrom As. kitinnê, linen, cloth, = Ar. Arabic; v. also Aram. כִּיתָּנָא, Syriac and infr.)

k.dt.aa.html:
[כָּתַר] vb. surround (in Pi.)
Pi. of surrounding an enemy
Hiph. throw out crowns, i.e. appear with crowns

k.dt.ac.html: כֹּתֶ֫רֶת, כּוֹתֶ֫רֶת n.f. capital of a pillar (as surrounding, crowning its top)

k.du.aa.html: [כָּתַשׁ] vb. pound, pound fine, bray;—Qal Pr 27:22

k.du.ab.html: מַכְתֵּשׁ n.m. mortar (place of pounding, braying)

k.dv.aa.html:
[כָּתַת] vb. beat, crush by beating
Qal
1 beat or crush fine
2 beat, hammer (ploughshares into swords)
Pi. Pf.;—as Qal 1. beat or crush fine
Pu. and they were beaten in pieces, one nation against another.
Hiph. beat in pieces an enemy
Hoph. and to ruins is the gate crushed

k.dv.ab.html: כָּתִית adj. beaten;—only in combin. beaten oil, i.e. oil made by beating or pounding the olives in a mortar; esp. fine and costly

k.dv.ac.html: [מְכִתָּה] n.f. the crushed or pulverized = coll. crushed fragments;—sg. sf. Is 30:14
